title: WebMCP

official_sources.source: W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group — WebMCP Draft
facts: ModelContextTool supports name, title, description, inputSchema, execute and annotations.
Tool annotations include readOnlyHint, untrustedContentHint, consequentialHint and debugging.
The tools permission-policy feature defaults to self.
WebMCP is an experimental proposed web standard and progressive enhancement.
Chrome exposes WebMCP through an origin trial starting in Chrome 149.
The imperative API supports form input, navigation, state management and other page-side functions.
Agents can discover registered tools and execute them through the ModelContext interface.

implementation_policy: Use document.modelContext as the primary API; navigator.modelContext is compatibility fallback only.
Expose only existing Keshavarz20 UI logic; do not invent parallel hydraulic or compatibility logic.
Do not let browser agents place real orders, send messages, alter price/stock or issue invoices in Phase 13.
Shipping amount stays null when the current carrier method is pay-on-delivery and no source-backed rate formula exists.
